rows.section: Manage recycling obligations home page for producer and CSO users
rows.english: Acquire and accept packaging waste recycling notes (PRNs) and packaging waste export recycling notes (PERNs) until your recycling obligations are fully met. Select a material for information on how the data was calculated and view your progress towards meeting your {{year}} recycling obligations.
rows.welsh: Ewch ati i gaffael a derbyn nodiadau ailgylchu gwastraff pecynwaith (PRNs) a nodiadau ailgylchu allforio gwastraff pecynwaith (PERNs) nes bod eich rhwymedigaethau ailgylchu wedi'u bodloni'n llawn. Dewiswch ddeunydd i gael gwybodaeth am sut y cyfrifwyd y data a gweld eich cynnydd tuag at fodloni’ch rhwymedigaethau ailgylchu {{year}}.

rows.english: How to meet the glass recycling obligation
rows.welsh: Sut i gyflawni'r rhwymedigaeth ailgylchu gwydr

rows.section: Manage recycling obligations home page for producer and CSO users
rows.english: A minimum of {{glassTarget}}% of your glass recycling obligation must be made up of glass re-melt PRNs or PERNs. This will make up a proportion of your overall glass recycling obligation. The remaining glass recycling obligation can be met by either glass re-melt, glass other or a mix of both.
rows.welsh: Rhaid i {{glassTarget}}% o leiaf o'ch rhwymedigaeth ailgylchu gwydr fod yn PRNs neu PERNs gwydr aildoddi. Bydd hyn yn ffurfio cyfran o gyfanswm eich rhwymedigaeth ailgylchu gwydr. Gall gweddill y rhwymedigaeth ailgylchu gwydr gael ei gyflawni ar ffurf gwydr aildoddi, gwydr arall neu gymysgedd o'r ddau.
